text.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ سَبْحًۭا طَوِيلًۭا

words.gloss_range: emphatic annulling particle opening the whole delayed nominal clause

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the final adjective through which the opening particle's clause scope extends

words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) opens 73:7 as an asserted explanation, not as another command after the night instructions. Its emphatic force and annulling grammar hold the whole clause through {{ar:طَوِيلًا}} ({{tr:ṭawīlā}}), so the daytime allowance is structurally certified rather than loosely appended. Because 73:6 also opens with {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}), the repetition makes night intensity and day breadth sound like paired assertions. The doubled n-sound gives the opening a compressed firmness before the verse unfolds into the long daytime phrase.

topics.headline: emphasis scopes the whole day claim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the daytime field is asserted with governing force, so night discipline is not allowed to cancel ordinary daytime scope.
topics.reason: QAC marks {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) as an emphatic annulling particle, and attachment evidence makes it govern the delayed noun {{ar:سَبْحًا}} ({{tr:sabḥan}}) inside one clause.

topics.headline: assertion replaces command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees 73:7 explaining the prior night command by naming a recognized day sphere rather than adding a new imperative.
topics.reason: The sentence-initial particle begins a declarative inna-clause after the preceding command material, making the ayah a counterbalancing assertion.

topics.headline: repeated opener pairs night and day
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the same emphatic opener join 73:6 and 73:7 as complementary panels, one for night and one for day.
topics.reason: The row evidence links the repeated {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) at the 73:6-73:7 boundary with the local clause function.

topics.headline: sound makes the assertion firm
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a tight emphatic onset before the broader daytime wording opens out.
topics.reason: The phonetic row is compatible with the emphatic particle and adds an audible payoff without changing the parse.

words.gloss_range: fronted lām plus second-person masculine singular suffix, locally assigning the daytime field to the addressee

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the emphatic opener after which the addressee allocation appears

words.prose: {{ar:لَكَ}} ({{tr:laka}}) makes the daytime breadth personal before the verse names either the day or the activity. The lām and attached suffix route the allowance to the direct addressee, while the fronted position makes that allocation the first semantic focus after {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}). Its force is benefactive and quasi-possessive: the day is available as assigned room, not merely mentioned as neutral time. This keeps 73:7 tied to the same addressed figure from 73:1 and balances the prior night demand with a recognized sphere for embodied movement.

topics.headline: the day scope is assigned to you
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the daytime field is not generic; it is routed to the addressed messenger by the suffix.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the second-person masculine singular suffix in {{ar:لَكَ}} ({{tr:laka}}), and attachment evidence links the suffix to the continuing direct addressee.

topics.headline: allocation comes before time and activity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the addressee placed before the day-frame and before the movement noun, making relation prior to schedule.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks {{ar:لَكَ}} ({{tr:laka}}), with {{ar:فِي ٱلنَّهَارِ}} ({{tr:fī al-nahāri}}), as the fronted predicate of the inna-clause.

topics.headline: the lām makes day usable room
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the phrase grants usable daytime scope rather than simply stating that activity happens during day.
topics.reason: The guardrail evidence names the role as beneficiary and relates the lām-governed pronoun to {{ar:سَبْحًا}} ({{tr:sabḥan}}).

topics.headline: relation and addressee are one surface unit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees allocation and addressee fused in one compact word at the center of the clause transition.
topics.reason: The local form is a preposition plus bound pronoun, and its position after {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) gives it the relational center of the new assertion.

words.gloss_range: temporal-locative preposition, locally making the day the container or field for movement

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the definite day-word governed by the preposition

words.prose: {{ar:فِي}} ({{tr:fī}}) turns {{ar:ٱلنَّهَارِ}} ({{tr:al-nahāri}}) into the field within which the coming {{ar:سَبْحًا}} ({{tr:sabḥan}}) occurs. Its temporal sense is primary, but the container force keeps day from becoming a mere schedule label: the reader enters a medium of daytime movement. Placed after {{ar:لَكَ}} ({{tr:laka}}), it pivots from who receives the allowance to where that allowance operates. Its liaison with the following definite day-word also makes the governed phrase sound tightly bound.

topics.headline: day becomes the movement field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that day is grammatically entered as a container for movement, not merely named as a time on a schedule.
topics.reason: QAC marks {{ar:فِي}} ({{tr:fī}}) as temporal-locative, and attachment evidence makes it govern {{ar:ٱلنَّهَارِ}} ({{tr:al-nahāri}}) as the time span for {{ar:سَبْحًا}} ({{tr:sabḥan}}).

topics.headline: the temporal relation has its own slot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the clause separate addressee allocation from temporal setting instead of folding both into one possessive statement.
topics.reason: {{ar:فِي}} ({{tr:fī}}) stands as an independent preposition after fused {{ar:لَكَ}} ({{tr:laka}}), creating a separate governed day phrase.

topics.headline: the day frame arrives before the activity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader processes the night-day contrast before learning the specific daytime movement that fills it.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase precedes the delayed noun {{ar:سَبْحًا}} ({{tr:sabḥan}}) inside the same inna-clause.

topics.headline: recitation binds preposition and day
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the preposition and the definite day-word as one closely governed phrase.
topics.reason: The phonetic row concerns the recited link between {{ar:فِي}} ({{tr:fī}}) and the hamzat-waṣl onset of {{ar:ٱلنَّهَارِ}} ({{tr:al-nahāri}}), and it coheres with the syntactic government.

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the movement noun whose temporal field is the day

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلنَّهَارِ}} ({{tr:al-nahāri}}) fixes the known daylight span before the verse names the movement inside it. Governed by {{ar:فِي}} ({{tr:fī}}), the word is not subject or object but the bounded field for {{ar:سَبْحًا}} ({{tr:sabḥan}}); its definiteness gathers the day into one recognizable counter-domain while the activity remains indefinite. The n-h-r family can carry river-flow and outward force, and beside the swimming-motion noun that flow pressure usefully colors the day as a traversable current, while local grammar keeps ordinary daytime as the selected sense and leaves rebuke or causative-flow branches aside. The supplied n-h-r plus s-b-h references (21:20, 21:33, 36:40, 41:38, 20:130) make the local day-and-movement pairing nonaccidental. The word also pivots the surah from 73:6's night intensity into open daytime breadth, and the later return of {{ar:ٱلنَّهَارِ}} ({{tr:al-nahāri}}) in 73:20 confirms that day remains a real sphere of movement.

topics.headline: the known day contains open movement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a fixed daylight container paired with an unnamed range of daytime movement.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark {{ar:ٱلنَّهَارِ}} ({{tr:al-nahāri}}) as a definite genitive noun governed by {{ar:فِي}} ({{tr:fī}}) and functioning as the time span for {{ar:سَبْحًا}} ({{tr:sabḥan}}).

topics.headline: day frames both assertion and activity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the day phrase doing more than locating one noun; it helps frame the whole asserted allowance.
topics.reason: The fronted predicate phrase and delayed governed noun belong to one inna construction, so the preposed day phrase bears local scope over the movement and the clause's temporal counterweight.

topics.headline: daylight carries river-like flow pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ordinary day-word as a traversable current beside the swimming-motion noun, while still reading it as daylight.
topics.reason: V4 and CRITICAL evidence support a shared daylight and river-flow root field, but the local surface is the abstract day noun, so the flow branch colors the image without replacing the selected sense.

topics.headline: rebuke and causative flow are not local senses
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the pressure of the wider n-h-r family without importing a rebuke verb or a causative act into this day noun.
topics.reason: The local form is a noun for day, not a verbal form of causing flow or rebuking; those branches are useful only as limits around the surviving flow-coloring topic.

topics.headline: night gives way to day
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the surah move from concentrated night discipline into the complementary daylight domain of movement.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL boundary rows are coherent with the local preposed day phrase after 73:6's night-focused assertion.

topics.headline: day and movement form a recurring field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the local day-and-movement pairing is not accidental, with supplied parallels (21:20, 21:33, 36:40, 41:38, 20:130) and a same-surah day return at 73:20.
topics.reason: The supplied cross-reference rows connect n-h-r with s-b-ḥ and identify a same-surah return of {{ar:ٱلنَّهَارِ}} ({{tr:al-nahāri}}) in 73:20, which can support but not control the local parse.

topics.headline: sound fuses the definite day phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the definite day-word tighten after the preposition and then open into the movement phrase.
topics.reason: The phonetic rows about article assimilation and root consonant movement fit the recited form and do not alter the syntactic role.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative maṣdar naming broad daytime movement or going about, locally the delayed noun of {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}})
words.root_gloss_range: broad s-b-ḥ range includes swimming or coursing, going about, praise and glorification, devotion, and variant relief imagery; local grammar selects daytime movement while keeping praise and ordered traversal as contextual pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the governing emphatic particle for the delayed movement noun
the adjective that agrees with and extends the movement noun
the preposed day-frame within which the movement noun is read
qiraat counterpoint that sharpens the canonical movement reading

words.prose: {{ar:سَبْحًا}} ({{tr:sabḥan}}) finally names what the fronted addressee and day-frame have been preparing: a broad, indefinite daytime movement. As the delayed accusative noun of {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}), it makes that movement a standing daytime condition rather than a single finite act, and its tanwīn leaves the concrete engagements unnamed while {{ar:طَوِيلًا}} ({{tr:ṭawīlā}}) locks onto it. The s-b-ḥ field brings swimming or coursing through a medium, so after {{ar:فِي ٱلنَّهَارِ}} ({{tr:fī al-nahāri}}) the day feels like an assigned field of ordered traversal; the cosmic swimming parallels at 21:33 and 36:40 sharpen that ordered-motion image without making this human daytime phrase cosmic. The word's sound moves from sliding sibilant through closure to breath-release, matching the boundary shift from night pressure to daytime dispersal. The same root turns in 73:8 toward explicit glorification, and the qiraat contrast with {{ar:سَبْخًا}} ({{tr:sabkhan}}) shows how close the verse is to lightening, thinning, or rest as a relief-reading, but the canonical local word remains movement through the day. The rare length pairing at 76:26 lets duration belong to both night devotion and daytime movement.

topics.headline: the delayed noun resolves the clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels recipient and day-field build suspense until the movement noun finally resolves the assertion.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes {{ar:سَبْحًا}} ({{tr:sabḥan}}) the accusative governed noun of {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}), following the fronted predicate elements.

topics.headline: movement is named, not verbalized
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the verse names a condition of daytime movement rather than narrating one discrete action.
topics.reason: QAC identifies {{ar:سَبْحًا}} ({{tr:sabḥan}}) as a gerund or maṣdar, and the nominal inna-clause supports a standing condition reading.

topics.headline: tanwīn leaves the activity open
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the day fixed but the specific daytime engagements left wide and unenumerated.
topics.reason: QAC marks {{ar:سَبْحًا}} ({{tr:sabḥan}}) as indefinite accusative, and attachment evidence confirms {{ar:طَوِيلًا}} ({{tr:ṭawīlā}}) agrees with and qualifies it.

topics.headline: swimming imagery becomes daytime traversal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader imagines daytime activity as movement through an assigned medium, while local grammar keeps the sense to human going about.
topics.reason: V4 supports swimming, coursing, and going-about branches for s-b-ḥ, but the local phrase {{ar:فِي ٱلنَّهَارِ}} ({{tr:fī al-nahāri}}) selects daytime movement rather than literal swimming.

topics.headline: movement points forward to praise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the root's praise field is not absent; it is redirected into explicit command language in 73:8.
topics.reason: The local maṣdar names daytime movement, while the next ayah's related Form II command activates explicit glorification; this supports a forward root pivot without replacing the local sense.

topics.headline: variant relief sharpens canonical movement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees how a tiny sound-and-letter shift could turn the day function toward lightening, which clarifies the canonical word's active movement.
topics.reason: The qiraat counterpoint is useful contrast, but the canonical local surface is {{ar:سَبْحًا}} ({{tr:sabḥan}}), so {{ar:سَبْخًا}} ({{tr:sabkhan}}) cannot govern the local parse.

topics.headline: cosmic swimming clarifies ordered motion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader reads broad daytime motion as ordered traversal inside a field, with 21:33 and 36:40 as clarifying parallels.
topics.reason: The supplied references at 21:33 and 36:40 support bounded-motion imagery; they function as parallels and do not override the local human daytime frame.

topics.headline: sound and boundary make movement felt
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears and feels a shift from compressed night discipline into kinetic daytime breadth.
topics.reason: The sound rows and boundary rows cohere with the word's local role as the movement noun after 73:6's night-focused register.

topics.headline: long movement recalls long devotion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that {{ar:سَبْحًا طَوِيلًا}} ({{tr:sabḥan ṭawīlā}}) belongs to a marked length-and-s-b-ḥ pairing also signaled at 76:26.
topics.reason: The cooccurrence evidence gives 76:26 as the comparison point for the s-b-ḥ plus ṭ-w-l pairing, supporting a marked parallel without flattening the local day movement.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative adjective qualifying {{ar:سَبْحًا}} ({{tr:sabḥan}}) as extended
words.root_gloss_range: broad ṭ-w-l range includes length, duration, capacity, means, prolonging, and overreaching; the local adjective selects measured extension and reach without causative or competitive force

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the movement noun qualified by the final adjective

words.prose: {{ar:طَوِيلًا}} ({{tr:ṭawīlā}}) closes the ayah by measuring the movement, not the day by itself. Its accusative indefinite agreement binds it to {{ar:سَبْحًا}} ({{tr:sabḥan}}), so the activity is the extended thing, and the postposed adjective makes extent the predicate's final landing. The ṭ-w-l field adds more than clock length: it can suggest duration, capacity, and operational reach, while the local adjective excludes causative prolonging and overreaching forms. Because the same supplied comparison points to 76:26, where length belongs to night devotion, this final word lets 73:7 place length in daytime movement without making day outrank night. At the boundary, 73:8's intensified turning answers this extended movement with focused devotion. Its long vowels and matching tanwīn cadence make the closing word sound stretched as it names extension.

topics.headline: length qualifies the movement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that what is long is the daytime movement, not merely the daylight span.
topics.reason: QAC marks {{ar:طَوِيلًا}} ({{tr:ṭawīlā}}) as an accusative adjective, and attachment evidence says it agrees with and qualifies {{ar:سَبْحًا}} ({{tr:sabḥan}}).

topics.headline: extent lands at the close
topics.reader_payoff: The reader reaches the end of the ayah with scale as the last interpretive pressure.
topics.reason: The adjective follows {{ar:سَبْحًا}} ({{tr:sabḥan}}) and is the final word of the ayah, so its position makes extent the closing measure.

topics.headline: longness includes reach, not overreach
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the day movement as prolonged and operationally expansive, not just many hours on a clock.
topics.reason: The wider ṭ-w-l field supports duration and capacity, but the local adjective simply qualifies {{ar:سَبْحًا}} ({{tr:sabḥan}}), so the capacity sense is retained as pressure rather than a separate lexical replacement.

topics.headline: the form avoids making or overreaching
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps extension as a measured quality of the movement instead of importing causative prolonging or competitive self-stretching.
topics.reason: The local word is an adjective on the faʿīl pattern, not a causative or overreaching verbal form from the same root field.

topics.headline: extension is a stable quality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees length attached as a quality of the open movement phrase rather than as a new action imposed on it.
topics.reason: The form is an indefinite adjective agreeing with {{ar:سَبْحًا}} ({{tr:sabḥan}}), preserving both qualitative extension and semantic openness.

topics.headline: long day movement answers long night devotion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 76:26 lets length qualify night devotion there while 73:7 lets it qualify daytime movement here.
topics.reason: The supplied comparison at 76:26 supports a marked ṭ-w-l plus s-b-ḥ duration field, while local grammar keeps {{ar:طَوِيلًا}} ({{tr:ṭawīlā}}) attached to daytime {{ar:سَبْحًا}} ({{tr:sabḥan}}).

topics.headline: sound performs the length
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final adjective stretch the ayah acoustically as it names extension.
topics.reason: The sound rows cohere with the final adjective's lexical meaning and closing position without changing the grammar.

topics.headline: breadth is balanced by focus
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final breadth of daytime movement positioned between 73:6's prior night evaluation and 73:8's concentrated turning.
topics.reason: The boundary rows connect the final length word to the preceding evaluative contrast and the following command sequence, while the local word remains an adjective of {{ar:سَبْحًا}} ({{tr:sabḥan}}).

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction laka fi al-nahari sabhan tawilan assigns the addressee an extended daytime sabh.
baseline_models.mechanism: Daylight opens a visible temporal field; sabh supplies room to go about livelihood, and tawil supplies both duration and capacity. Together they describe an extended operating range rather than mere clock length.

activation_trace.role: The opening of day by light supplies the temporal field in which the activity becomes possible.
Room for going about and livelihood gives sabh its practical daytime motion.
Long duration extends that practical movement across the day.
Capacity and means make long describe usable scope as well as elapsed time.

changed_reading.before: The ayah merely notes that the daytime is long or busy.
changed_reading.after: The ayah grants an extended daylight operating range for movement, livelihood, and practical disposal.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Al-nahar, sabhan, and tawilan can be read together through their opening, coursing, and extension images.
baseline_models.mechanism: The day is an opened expanse resembling a channel, while sabh is coursing or swimming and tawil stretches the course. The clause becomes kinetic: the addressee moves through daylight rather than merely possessing tasks inside it.

activation_trace.role: Opening and widening until flow is possible turns daylight into traversable space.
Swimming or coursing supplies the agent's sustained movement through that space.
Length and extension make the course prolonged.

changed_reading.before: Sabh is an abstract label for daytime busyness.
changed_reading.after: Daylight is an opened, extended medium through which the addressee courses.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The noun sabh is directly attached to the focus root س ب ح, whose inventory includes worship through praise and prayer.
baseline_models.mechanism: The worship branch of sabh and the long-duration branch of tawil preserve a focus-only alternative in which daytime carries an extended current of praise or prayer, not only outward occupation.

activation_trace.role: The opening of daylight locates the possible devotional current in the day.
Worship through praise and prayer supplies the devotional sense of sabh.
Long duration keeps that worship available as a sustained daytime reading.

changed_reading.before: Sabh denotes only secular movement or free disposal.
changed_reading.after: The wording also permits a long daylight current of praise, prayer, or remembrance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Night rising concentrates effort, while divine measuring, human inability to exhaustively count, and subsequent ease regulate the duration. The long daytime sabh therefore functions as the released half of a measured night-day rhythm, not as an undifferentiated block of busyness.

activation_trace.role: Room for going about and livelihood supplies the released daytime range being regulated.
Capacity and means let long denote available scope rather than a fixed quota.
Resolve and rising into an undertaking supply the concentrated nocturnal posture.
Undertaking an affair at night marks the focused side of the temporal alternation.
Ordering by measure turns the night-day contrast into calibrated allocation.
Exhaustive counting names the human limit that prevents duration from becoming an exacting quota.
Opening into ease after difficulty supplies the release that calibrates both practice and daytime range.

structural_cues: The focus ayah follows the night-rising sequence and explicitly switches to daytime.
The final ayah returns to both night and day, measurement, inability to count, and what is manageable.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concentrated night rising, measured night and day, failed exhaustive counting, and ease; I infer that the daytime sabh is the compensating release in that rhythm. A live alternative is that 73:20 relaxes only recitation quantity and does not redefine sabh.

changed_reading.before: Daytime offers a simply long span for ordinary activity.
changed_reading.after: Daytime is the expansive, mercifully calibrated release paired with concentrated night practice.

context_deltas.mechanism: A saying is received as weight and the night gives firmer footing or correspondence. Against that preparation, the focus's long coursing becomes the daytime transport and enactment of what was received, so mobility carries weight rather than escaping it.

Useful substance lets the long course bear consequential content rather than empty duration.
Receiving speech by taking and instruction supplies the content placed upon the addressee.

Weight opposed to lightness gives the received saying its load-bearing demand.
One thing corresponding firmly to another supplies the fit between nocturnal formation and daytime enactment.

structural_cues: The heavy saying and firmer nocturnal footing immediately precede the focus ayah.
The focus pivots from reception and formation at night to prolonged movement by day.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies received speech, weight, correspondence, and daytime coursing; I supply the arrow that nocturnal reception equips daytime enactment. Alternatively, the clauses may only contrast ideal recitation time with daytime distraction.

changed_reading.before: The long daytime course is merely competing activity.
changed_reading.after: The long daytime course is also the field where weighty received speech is carried and enacted.

context_deltas.mechanism: Exclusive inward severance, entrusting affairs to a sufficient guardian, self-restraint, and deliberate separation bound the focus's wide daytime movement. The result is not withdrawal from all contact but a controlled way of moving through prolonged social exposure.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies severance, entrusted sufficiency, restraint, and separation; I infer that they govern how one inhabits the long daytime range. The alternative is a sequence of independent commands with no social specification of sabh.

changed_reading.before: Daytime range means unrestricted outward busyness.
changed_reading.after: Daytime range is prolonged engagement bounded by exclusive orientation, entrusted care, restraint, and selective disengagement.

context_deltas.mechanism: Explicit remembrance soon after the focus and established prayer in the closing recalibration keep the worship branch of sabh active across the daylight field. Devotion is concentrated at night but not confined there.

changed_reading.after: Remembrance and prayer make a sustained daytime devotional current a live co-reading alongside livelihood movement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The free, extended course of the focus is set against fetters, violent shaking, solid heights becoming poured matter, and a split sky. Daytime traversability is therefore provisional: the apparently stable arena of action can close, convulse, or lose its footing.

Coursing supplies the mobility later images negate or destabilize.
Long duration makes the present corridor feel ample while leaving its endpoint exposed.

structural_cues: The warning sequence escalates from restraint to terrestrial convulsion and celestial rupture.
The focus's long movement precedes this sequence, creating a temporal contrast between present access and future closure.

changed_reading.before: The long day is a stable and repeatable arena for movement.
changed_reading.after: The long day is a provisional corridor for action before restraint and cosmic instability remove ordinary traversability.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing ayah names ease, impaired motion, travel through the earth, seeking bounty, and combat as unequal embodied conditions. These make sabh's room for livelihood concrete and recast tawil as broad available capacity whose actual use differs by person and circumstance.

activation_trace.role: Room for going about and livelihood is concretized by the later catalog of outward conditions.
Capacity and means allow long to vary with embodied and practical ability.
Ease opening after difficulty makes practicability, rather than maximal duration, the regulating principle.
Weakening and curtailed motion supply an embodied limit on daytime range.

structural_cues: The final ayah explicitly differentiates illness, earth-travel for bounty, and combat.
Its repeated manageable-reading formula embeds devotion within those unequal practical conditions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ease, limited motion, travel, seeking, bounty, and combat; I infer that this closing catalog instantiates and calibrates the focus's daytime sabh. Alternatively, the catalog may explain only the concession in recitation and leave 73:7 at a generic level.

changed_reading.before: Long sabh is a uniform quantity of daytime busyness.
changed_reading.after: Long sabh is differentiated practical capacity: livelihood travel and other outward demands occupy unequal bodies, while devotion is scaled to what opens with ease.

It remains anchored in the focus's ط و ل inventory and gains a coherent material contrast from cutting and fettering images; downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory analogy for wide but bounded freedom, not as a lexical replacement for 'long.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Tawilan activates the root's tether-rope image beside sabh's room for going about.

changed_reading.after: The day grants a long radius of movement whose extension remains bounded by attachment, duty, and eventual restraint.

It remains anchored by the focus root's opening and watercourse branches, sabh's coursing branch, and later path and earth-travel cues; downstream prose should mark it as a spatial metaphor that reveals flow, not as an alternate dictionary gloss for the verse.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus places coursing sabh inside al-nahar and extends it with tawilan.

activation_trace.role: A river cutting a channel through earth supplies the material shape of the day-course.

Extension stretches the channel into a prolonged route.
An extended path that is actually traveled converts the flow image into directed passage.

changed_reading.after: The day is an opened channel or route through which the addressee must keep coursing.

strongest_changes: The long daytime span became the released and measured half of a night-day rhythm rather than mere busyness.
The closing catalog concretized sabh as unequal embodied capacity for livelihood travel and other outward demands.
The heavy saying and firmer footing made daytime motion a possible field of carrying and enacting what night receives.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's three roots sustain several coexisting mechanisms: daylight opens a field, sabh can mean livelihood-range, physical coursing, or devotion, and tawil can mark duration, usable capacity, or, exploratorily, tethered extension. Context does not collapse these; it measures, moralizes, and spatializes them.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether sabh's primary force is practical going-about, physical coursing, or devotional praise remains unresolved.
The degree to which the closing concession directly glosses 73:7 rather than merely revisiting the surah's schedule is uncertain.
The tether and channel readings are coherent branch-based analogies but should not displace the ordinary daylight syntax.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Daytime is extended circulation for livelihood.** `س ب ح` B005 explicitly supplies room for going about, livelihood activity, movement, and distance in the land; `ط و ل` B003 supplies long duration. The night/day contrast is later made concrete in 73:20 by the sick, travelers striking through the earth for bounty, and fighters. I infer that worldly circulation consumes the long daytime interval. The fixed ayah therefore names an occupational and social expanse, not generic busyness.

2. **The day can feel like continuous coursing.** `س ب ح` B004 supplies swimming or coursing through a medium, and `ط و ل` B001 supplies extension. The prepositional frame `في النهار` makes the day the medium through which movement occurs. I infer that repeated obligations create swimmer-like continuous motion. This reading preserves the experiential image of being carried through a long field of activity beside the livelihood reading.

3. **Length can also be capacity.** `ط و ل` B004 supplies bounty, means, and capacity. Because 73:20 identifies travel specifically as seeking divine bounty, I infer that the long daytime range is enabled opportunity, not merely delay before night. The ayah can consequently read as granting broad capacity for movement while reserving nocturnal concentration.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 73:20 supplies the unexpected concrete gloss: some are sick, some travel through the earth seeking bounty, and others fight. This changes `سبحًا طويلًا` from vague daytime occupation into differentiated bodily, economic, and martial circulation.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Daylight opens an extended operational field.** **Lexical evidence:** `ن ه ر B002` is the daylight period, but `ن ه ر B003` is opening or widening until something flows; `س ب ح B005` is room for going about and livelihood, and `ط و ل B001/B003` supplies extension and long duration. **Structural cue and role:** the tightly apportioned night of 73:2-6 is followed by a day characterized by open, prolonged movement. The widening branch makes day the opened channel, and `سبح` names activity moving through it. **Abductive move:** the temporal contrast and motion noun are supplied; I infer a division of labor between concentrated night formation and dispersed daytime obligations. **Reading change:** the day is not merely "busy"; it is an expanded field through which the addressee must circulate.

2. **A horizon-spanning course.** **Lexical evidence:** `س ب ح B004` is swimming or coursing through water or air, and `ط و ل B001` is spatial extension; 73:9 immediately names east and west through `ش ر ق B001` and `غ ر ب B006`. **Structural cue and role:** the motion image is placed between night practice and the two horizon limits. It gives `سبحا` the role of traversing the broad interval those limits define. **Abductive move:** motion and horizons are supplied; I infer that the course is socially and spatially extensive rather than a static possession of time. **Reading change:** `سبحا طويلا` can be heard as a long course through the day, not only an abundance of tasks.

3. **Long leeway contrasted with a short reprieve.** **Lexical evidence:** `ط و ل B007` is prolonging, delaying, or granting time; 73:11 uses `م ه ل B001` for granting time and `ق ل ل B001` for its small amount. **Structural cue and role:** the addressee receives a long daytime field, while the deniers receive only `قليلا` of postponement. **Abductive move:** the opposed duration language is supplied; I infer that time is allocated according to different functions, operational room here and bounded deferment there. **Reading change:** `طويلا` acquires the force of granted working leeway, sharply distinct from indefinite delay.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The short reprieve in 73:11 was the surprising later correction to `طويلا`: length is not a generic property of all granted time. It distinguishes broad operational leeway for the addressee from tightly bounded postponement for the deniers.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyin kendi yapısındaki uzanımı ve başka bir şeyi boy bakımından geçmesini birlikte bildirir. Bu çerçeve, genel uzunluk çekirdeğini ve karşılaştırmalı kullanımı doğru biçimde temsil eder.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal yalnız fiziksel ya da ölçülebilir uzanımı kapsar; zaman, güç, bağ ipi, böbürlenme ve işi geciktirme anlamlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel uzunluk anlamı yalın biçimlerde bulunur; boyca geçme, özel beden niteliği, bakmak için doğrulma ve belirli adlandırmalar yalnız kendi kuruluşları içinde değerlendirilir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin kendi doğrultusunda uzanması, kısalığın karşıtı ve genişlikten ayrı bir ölçü yönü olarak uzunluk taşımasıdır. Karşılaştırmalı kullanımda bir varlığın başka bir varlığı boy bakımından geçmesini de anlatır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin kendi yapısı ya da ölçüsü boyunca uzanması ve uzunluk niteliği taşımasıdır.
Karşılaştırılan bir varlığın ötekinden daha uzun olması ve onu boyca geçmesidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar anlamı uzanım, uzun olma ve kısalığın karşıtı olma çevresinde birleştirir; ayrıca birinin ötekini boyca geçmesini bu çekirdeğin karşılaştırmalı kullanımı olarak verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Genel uzanım çekirdeğini ve bunun karşılaştırmalı kullanımını birlikte adlandırmak için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Hem bir şeyin uzun olmasını hem de başka bir şeyi boyca geçmesini korur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Özel bağ ipinin adı yalın biçimde bulunur; atın bağını merada gevşetme anlamı ise yalnız belirtilen eylem kuruluşuna bağlıdır.

word_morpheme_spans.note: Accepted bridge links preserve independent analysis identities. Several analysis entries may share canonical morphemes. Read their distinct semantic claims; shared morphology alone is not duplication. Legacy aligned_qac_word_ref values are source observations, not QAC joins. Excluded source entries remain available with their explicit qualification.

word_analysis_qac_alignment.note: Legacy analysis and QAC numbers are separate source namespaces. Use accepted word_morpheme_spans for actual many-to-many joins. The legacy numbering observation is preserved, not used for alignment.

channel_review.note: first-pass blind review by a single reader; no adjudication, no accept/reject, no per-ayah channel maturity. Not a channel ledger.

channel_generated_outputs.note: Generated network-v3 channel discovery/family/path outputs are available as external quran-data files; read them only when channel detail is necessary, and do not treat them as an adjudicated channel ledger.

missing_branch_inventories.reason: no accepted, non-contaminated branch inventory in resource

full_context_packet.note: surah-scope fallback: the default commentary workflow does not consume per-ayah focus packets, so the source packet is scoped by this builder to roots this ayah can justify and carries no staged reveal order

scoping.note: SCOPED, NOT ABSENT. The surah-scope fallback inventory covers every root in the surah; it is narrowed here to roots this ayah can justify -- roots occurring in this ayah (all their branches kept, unconditionally, because Layer 2 selects nothing) plus roots explicitly cited by channel material anchored here (only the cited branches kept, enough to resolve the citation). A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.

v12_reader_responses.note: Per-ayah focus-run reader responses are retired from the default commentary workflow. Use regular reader walks, plus/minus-5 reader walks, and cross-run publication findings for corpus-wide reader-derived evidence.

v12_cross_run_publication.note: Compact final cross-run findings for this ayah, reconciled upstream from regular and plus/minus-5 reader runs; use as a coverage/priority check, not as replacement prose.

occurrence_evidence_trim.note: TRIMMED, NOT ABSENT. dictionary_entry.occurrence_evidence.occurrences and .ayahs are removed from every root by design: they are a per-occurrence QAC concordance and character-span alignment table carrying zero readings, branches or senses, and they dominated bundle size (~1.5 MB for a single common root). occurrence_evidence.summary (corpus frequency) and .forms (inflectional inventory) are retained. Dictionary/gloss branches are kept in full for every included Furuq root target.

branch_policy.note: No branch filtering is applied. Every branch present in each included dictionary/gloss root entry is kept.

root_mapping.policy: Use the dominant Furuq root for every QAC root, and include non-dominant Furuq targets as additional root_lexicon entries when qac-furuq-v4-root-map marks the QAC root as split.
